Definition: to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to do a third time, do three times, divide in three parts; 1a) (Piel) to do a third time, divide into three parts; 1b) (Pual) to be three years of age, be threefold
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
